claims.statement: Panasonic's catalog identifies CGR18650CH as a bare 18650 high-rate cell, approximately 18.6 mm x 65.2 mm; aggregate records identify it as flat-top and unprotected.
Steam Engine preserves Panasonic CGR18650CH 2250mAh 4.4C as a 2250mAh preset with a 4.4C runtime rating.
Panasonic CGR18650CH is documented as a lithium-ion cell, but the exact cathode chemistry was not established in this pass.
The exact catalog entry Panasonic CGR18650CH has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2011-04-18 or earlier.

authenticity.summary: No entry-specific authenticity assessment was established in this catalog pass; exact wrapper, batch, or pack provenance remains unresolved.
